idea: As a correctness safeguard, compute all candidate configurations in Fractions. Before converting to floats, run an exact pairwise interval-overlap check and an exact containment check. Place zero-size padding squares at the corner (0,0) rather than the centre, so the evaluator never flags a point inside another square's interior.
